name: Guardian cryptic crossword, Penguin book 5 No 23

clue.text: Surely not where one with The Cloth abides in sin!
Agent Brown about to cut groove in snare
Leave without transport in London
Steer towards Cornwall in the third person? He might
A river, not in France, I repeat!
Coarse emission from rough shale
Constituents of either half of Circle’s Meeting
Duets played to introduce bishop at intervals
‘The sleepless soul that perished in his pride’ (Wordsworth)
Covetousness in bar? The other way around
Box weight: a piano between conductors
Gathering for discussion following game short at both ends
The point of reproduction
Back end of print fit hoof on edge — walker seeks it
Afflicted man, covered in leg rash, gets to be excessive
Puccini’s insanely running round to rub Underground Masters up the wrong way
Result of fridge breakdown in deli’s bad luck!
Heavenly body that rises with the Sun?
Reported scruples under Charon?
Play it by ear? One would in dark room!
e.g. Arctic Tern, one-year nag, must achieve this!
Suppression of one in context?
Break journey and s-suffer loss of head
Cut tree after grudging start
